title: Word Spreads
staging:
Scene 06 — Word Spreads

05:00–05:45 · 45 sec · District 7 market

Trixie and Byte return to the slums. Byte shares the suspicious pricing data with the crew. Neon projects the price increases onto a public billboard. Curious cats gather.

Shots: Crowded market wide → price-history hologram → shocked citizens → Trixie climbing onto a crate.

lines.text: They tripled the price before they announced the shortage!
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording

lines.text: Those bastards! I sold my litter box to buy dinner!
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording
